dark.$description: Dark-scheme overrides. ink and ink-2 are shared with the light palette. primary and teal STOPPED being shared on 2026-09-09: a single blue cannot pass WCAG AA on both #FFFFFF and #111C33, and the shared #2E6FF2 was failing in BOTH directions at once - 4.49:1 on the light card and 3.77:1 on the dark card, with every page declaring a{color:var(--primary)} inside a prefers-color-scheme block. Darkening it for light made dark worse, so the token forked. Measured: primary #6E9BFF is 6.95:1 on dark.bg and 6.30:1 on dark.card; teal #17C3A2 (the light palette's former value) is 8.35:1 and 7.57:1.
